name: mirage
text: Got it. That is PropLine's full OpenAPI spec (v1.2.0, 38 endpoints), and I saved it to the repo as research/propline/openapi_2026-10-24.json. Most of it was already in the docs I saved on 10-16, and the engine uses odds, ev, best-line, movement, results, trends and the exports. In the code I found no use of these: projections, the SGP endpoints, books/accuracy, coverage/history, freshness, injuries/history and the DFS payouts. I'll check which of those could help the bet star rating or the CLV work, and I'll build any that are worth having. I'll tell you what I find.
